# stone_floor class (2026-10-28): Salgin opaque paving, cobble, flagstone and brick tiles picked by eye from
# contact sheets of the native picture against the three models. realesrgan-x4plus-anime invents "cracked mosaic"
# lines and flattens the mortar on them; the general realesrgan-x4plus model keeps the stones, so the builder
# upscales these with x4plus. One pixel hash per line (16 hex characters of sha1(decoded RGBA + size)); no pixels.
